deployments_detail.use: Serverless image segmentation ML pipeline that analyzes high-content microscope imagery from biological experiments in drug discovery; uses custom (fine-tuned pre-trained) ML segmentation models orchestrated via AWS Step Functions Distributed Map, Lambda and S3, running up to 10,000 concurrent workflows. In production since April 2023. [AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, S3, Fargate); custom Vertex ML models]

Small-molecule virtual screening system using Thompson Sampling (a machine-learning bandit heuristic) to prioritize chemical compounds from large virtual libraries for experimental testing, built on AWS Fargate Spot, Lambda, and API Gateway. Used on active scientific projects. [AWS (Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, Amazon MQ); Thompson Sampling ML]
deployments_detail.value: 18-20x speedup vs serial approach; examined only 0.07% of library; a few hundred dollars per search

deployments_detail.use: ICF Autodrafter: a custom, fine-tuned LLM application that ingests clinical trial protocols and automatically drafts Informed Consent Forms, with human-in-the-loop review. Built by Vertex Global Clinical Trial Operations and internal AI teams; used across 10+ trials. Won 2025 DataIQ Award for Best Use of Data and AI for Healthcare. [Vertex internal AI team (custom fine-tuned LLM; provider not disclosed)]
deployments_detail.value: 90% reduction in document preparation time; 97% consistency with human-generated content; used on 10+ trials

deployments_detail.use: Multi-year drug-discovery collaboration using human genetics and machine learning to identify and validate novel therapeutic targets, and to select biomarkers / identify patient populations. Began 2018, extended 2021, and expanded again through 2026. [Genomics plc (proprietary ML algorithms and genomic databases)]

Structure-based drug design using computational modeling and AI — a foundational discovery approach Vertex says it has used since its founding, applied to designing small-molecule therapeutics. [not disclosed]
AI embedded as infrastructure in drug discovery process (own stories + CEO); no single named public system
Specialty Pharmacy analytics using AI to monitor shipments of cystic fibrosis medications and proactively identify issues that could cause shipping/delivery delays. [not disclosed]

Use of AI to accelerate preparation of regulatory filings/submissions, reducing administrative effort so scientists can focus on discovery (CEO Reshma Kewalramani described AI compressing typical 6-9 month filing-prep timelines). [not disclosed]
